venues.why: Fergus Henderson's nose-to-tail temple; roast bone marrow and parsley salad is mandatory.

venues.name: Hawksmoor Guildhall
venues.group_notes: Dedicated Guildhall private-dining rooms.

venues.name: Blacklock Soho
venues.group_notes: Group policy not stated online. Ask about 'All In' sharing for big tables.

venues.name: Brat

venues.name: The Guinea Grill

venues.name: Goodman Mayfair
venues.group_notes: Private dining offered (goodmanrestaurants.com/private-dining).

venues.name: Goodman City
venues.group_notes: Private dining offered (goodmanrestaurants.com/private-dining).
venues.why: City outpost of Goodman: same dry-aged beef, built for expense-account tables.

venues.name: Lutyens Grill
venues.group_notes: Parties of 7+ can book online. Unlimited prime rib on Fridays and Sundays. Open to non-members.
venues.why: Wood-panelled former bank manager's office with trolley carving. No. 35 in the World's 101 Best Steak Restaurants.

venues.name: The Devonshire
venues.group_notes: Private events: privateevents@devonshiresoho.co.uk (events brochure on site).
venues.why: London's hottest pub-grill: perfect Guinness downstairs and a wood-fired grill room upstairs. No. 45 in the World's 101 Best Steak Restaurants.

venues.name: Holborn Dining Room
venues.address: Rosewood London, 252 High Holborn, London WC1V 7EN

venues.name: Kitty Fisher's
venues.group_notes: Private hire offered (/private-hire).

venues.name: Savoy Grill

venues.why: Art-deco grill room serving beef Wellington and trolley classics, with the American Bar upstairs.

venues.name: Mountain
venues.group_notes: Group policy not stated online. Email bookings@mountainbeakstreet.com.
venues.why: Tomos Parry's Soho follow-up to Brat: open-fire Welsh/Spanish cooking and big-ticket shared cuts.

venues.name: Rules
venues.group_notes: Private rooms: the Graham Greene Room and the John Betjeman Room.
venues.why: London's oldest restaurant (1798): game from its own estate, pies and puddings in a room full of antlers.

venues.name: Wiltons
venues.group_notes: Private dining offered (/private-dining). Jacket is the expected dress.

venues.name: The Ritz Restaurant

venues.name: Simpson's in the Strand

venues.name: Scott's

venues.name: Bentley's Oyster Bar & Grill

venues.name: J. Sheekey
